title: web-toolkit
description: Utility functions for web projects: URL parsing, cookie helpers, fetch wrappers.

sections.readme:
# web-toolkit

A collection of utility functions for web development.

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/web-toolkit)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/web-toolkit)
sections.installation:
## Installation

```bash
pnpm add web-toolkit
```

```typescript
import { parseUrl, getCookie } from 'web-toolkit';
```
sections.contributing:
